metadata.title: OpenTUI runtime preflight and real native FFI smoke gate

work.objective: Prevent the OpenTUI renderer from reaching a cryptic native FFI crash on unsupported Node runtimes, provide an actionable Bun/runtime preflight, and add a real native FFI smoke gate.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for all reads, edits, searches and commands.
Only modify the allowed UI dispatch/runtime files; do not change OpenTUI product components, dependencies, lockfiles, Ink behavior, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
Do not claim Node 24 support: the locked @opentui/core 0.5.1 requires Bun or Node 26.1+ with experimental node:ffi.
context: A real user ran QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui node packages/cli/dist/index.js under Node v24.15.0 and hit: Failed to initialize OpenTUI render library: OpenTUI native FFI is not available for this runtime yet.
The same built CLI was independently launched in a real PTY with QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js; it rendered the banner/input/status UI and exited cleanly with Ctrl+C.
Existing 451 OpenTUI unit tests mock native FFI and therefore did not catch this startup blocker. Add focused tests for preflight behavior and keep default Ink/Node behavior unchanged.

When OpenTUI is selected under an unsupported runtime, fail before importing the native-dependent renderer module with a concise message that includes the verified Bun command. Bun must remain accepted. If implementing Node 26 experimental detection, be conservative and fail closed when node:ffi availability cannot be established.
The authoritative acceptance includes a real Bun resolveRenderLib probe, so test mocks alone cannot satisfy the task.
nonGoals: Do not implement a Node-to-Bun subprocess bridge.
Do not change the default renderer in this run.
Do not upgrade OpenTUI or Node dependencies.
Do not work on the parity harness or Solid.
